source_name: U.S. Department of State - Press Releases
title: Uzbekistan Independence Day
summary_raw:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
Press Statement


			
			


			
			
August 31, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I extend warm congratulations to the people of Uzbekistan as they celebrate 35 years of independence on September 1.
The U.S.-Uzbekistan strategic partnership is producing meaningful results across a range of shared priorities. From critical minerals, energy, and infrastructure, to aviation, finance, and technology, American and Uzbek businesses are expanding commercial ties and creating new opportunities for our two countries. The United States welcomes Uzbekistan’s tenure as the C5+1 Secretariat co-chair (2026-2027) and collaborative efforts to further strengthen regional security, connectivity, and economic growth.
As Uzbekistan celebrates this important milestone, the United States looks forward to building on this momentum and deepening a partnership that makes both our countries stronger, more secure, and more prosperous.

source_name: U.S. Department of State - Press Releases
title: Trinidad and Tobago National Day
summary_raw:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
Press Statement


			
			


			
			
August 31, 2026

On behalf of the United States, I congratulate the people of Trinidad and Tobago as they celebrate 64 years of independence.
The United States and Trinidad and Tobago share a longstanding partnership built on a mutual commitment to regional prosperity. Today, our relationship is stronger than ever as we work together to combat transnational crime, strengthen regional security, as well as support energy resilience and cooperation that benefits both our countries.
As you commemorate this important milestone, we celebrate the enduring friendship between our nations and look forward to continuing to advance our shared priorities and build an even stronger partnership in the years ahead.

title: Kyrgyz Republic Independence Day
summary_raw:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
Press Statement


			
			


			
			
August 31, 2026
On behalf of the United States of America, I extend my warm congratulations to the people of the Kyrgyz Republic as they celebrate 35 years of independence on August 31.
The United States and the Kyrgyz Republic continue to strengthen our bilateral relationship, with a focus on expanding commercial ties, advancing regional connectivity, and promoting security. Through the C5+1 platform, we work with the Kyrgyz Republic to advance regional cooperation and achieve shared economic, energy, and security goals.
As the Kyrgyz Republic celebrates this important milestone, the United States looks forward to building on our partnership and supporting a more connected, secure, and prosperous Central Asia.

source_name: U.S. Department of State - Press Releases
title: Malaysia Independence Day
summary_raw:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
Press Statement


			
			


			
			
August 30, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I send my warmest congratulations to the people of Malaysia on the 69th anniversary of Malaysia’s independence. 
For nearly seven decades, the United States and Malaysia have shared a deep and enduring partnership, rooted in strong economic ties, interpersonal bonds, and a shared commitment to freedom of navigation in a free and open Indo-Pacific. As one of Malaysia’s top investors and a valued trading partner, the United States looks forward to deepening this relationship in the years ahead.
On this special occasion, I wish all the people of Malaysia continued peace and prosperity.
